item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Yash looks at the graph of a cycle journey. Before he reads any value or pattern, he must decide what each axis, scale, marker, and line represents.

Which claim correctly states that first step?

options.A: Read the horizontal axis as time in minutes and the vertical axis as distance in kilometres from the labelled scales, then read points.
options.B: Read a distance from a marker before the axis scales are identified.
options.C: Reading the plotted points is what creates the axis labels.
options.D: Apply a pie-slice legend rule to these line-graph axes.
